# E0.0 — Tasks

Ordered. Each task is small enough to commit on its own and names the requirement IDs it serves
(written out, never as a range). A side with no tasks is not in the spec's `touches`. Outside Demo
mode tasks are test-first; in Demo mode there are no test tasks.

## Server

- [ ] **S1** (R1) — Implement … in `server.py` (`<function>`).
- [ ] **S2** (R2, R3) — …

## Overlay

- [ ] **O1** (R1) — Implement … in `overlay/<file>`.
- [ ] **O2** (R2) — Window/screen … with every state (server down, starting, error).
